name: Acheron

abilities.name: Trilateral Wilt
abilities.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to 100% of Acheron's ATK to a single target enemy.

abilities.description: Unleashes Rainblade 3 times and Stygian Resurge 1 time, dealing Lightning DMG up to 372% of Acheron's ATK to a single target and Lightning DMG up to 300% of Acheron's ATK to other targets. Reduces enemy All-Type RES by 20% during the Ultimate.

abilities.name: Quadruple Sever
abilities.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. At the start of each wave, deals Lightning DMG equal to 200% of Acheron's ATK to all enemies and reduces All-Type Toughness regardless of Weakness Type. Overworld regular enemies are instantly defeated without entering combat.

majorTraces.name: Red Oni
majorTraces.description: At the start of battle, immediately gains 5 points of Slashed Dream and applies 5 stacks of Crimson Knot to a random enemy. When Slashed Dream reaches maximum point cap, each excess point generates 1 stack of Quadruple Sever (up to 3).

majorTraces.description: When there are 1/2 other Nihility characters in the team, Acheron's Basic ATK, Skill, and Ultimate DMG increase to 115%/160% of the original DMG.

majorTraces.name: Thunder Core
majorTraces.description: When Rainblade hits enemies with Crimson Knot, Acheron's DMG increases by 30%, stacking up to 3 times for 3 turns, and deals additional DMG upon Stygian Resurge.

eidolons.name: Silenced Sky Begins in Pale Reverie
eidolons.description: Crit Rate increases by 18% when dealing DMG to debuffed enemies.
eidolons.keyMechanic: +18% Crit Rate vs debuffed enemies

eidolons.name: Mute Thunder in Still Tempest
eidolons.description: The number of Nihility characters required for Trace 'The Abyss' is reduced by 1. At the start of Acheron's turn, gains 1 point of Slashed Dream and inflicts 1 stack of Crimson Knot on the enemy with the most Crimson Knot.

eidolons.keyMechanic: Ultimate and Basic Attack level upgrades

eidolons.description: When enemies enter combat, inflicts Ultimate DMG Vulnerability state on them, increasing Ultimate DMG taken by 8%.

eidolons.name: Strewn Souls on Shattered Steps

eidolons.keyMechanic: Skill and Talent level upgrades

eidolons.description: Increases All-Type RES PEN of Ultimate DMG dealt by Acheron by 20%. The DMG dealt by Basic ATK and Skill is also considered Ultimate DMG and can reduce Toughness regardless of Weakness Type.
eidolons.keyMechanic: +20% All-Type RES PEN and converts all attacks to Ultimate Toughness-reducing DMG
